o: It handles tens of thousands of queries a month, including from state police
It originated as a response to the 2001 Parliament attack
Its analytical tools include entity resolution, facial recognition and machine learning
It engages the right to privacy recognised in K.S. Puttaswamy (2017)
ca17ef44234f00.x: NATGRID originated as a response to the 26/11 Mumbai attacks in 2008.

ca389819eaab57.s: The vector of lymphatic filariasis is:
ca389819eaab57.x: Culex quinquefasciatus is the vector of lymphatic filariasis.

caba0e821b10bb.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission, local body grants are split between basic and performance grants in the ratio:
caba0e821b10bb.x: Local body grants have an 80% basic and 20% performance structure; 90:10 is the disaster-cost sharing for NE and Himalayan states.

n2b44d8bfa7c.s: The 16th Finance Commission (award period 2026–31) kept the vertical devolution to States at:
n2b44d8bfa7c.x: Vertical devolution was kept at 41%; a new contribution-to-GDP criterion with 10% weight was added.

ca81b508c8f520.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for a commission on backward classes?
ca81b508c8f520.x: Article 340 provides for a commission on backward classes.

cad94bb133b65c.s: In India's counter-terrorism policy PRAHAAR, CBRNED stands for Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, Explosive and:
cad94bb133b65c.x: PRAHAAR defines CBRNED as Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear, Explosive and Digital.

ca35b436fa4ba5.s: Census 2027 is to include caste enumeration for the first time since:
ca35b436fa4ba5.x: Caste enumeration returns for the first time since 1931; the Census is conducted by the RGCC under the MHA.

caf7149245f64a.s: The malaria vaccines prioritised for Africa are:
caf7149245f64a.x: The malaria vaccines identified are RTS,S and R21, not BCG and OPV.

ca6997e56058b4.s: Law Commission Report 267 (2017) on hate speech proposed new Sections:
ca6997e56058b4.x: Law Commission Report 267 (2017) proposed new Sections 153C and 505A.

cae0907c82e1c4.s: Which is the most severe type of spina bifida?
cae0907c82e1c4.x: Myelomeningocele is the most severe type; folic acid in early pregnancy helps prevent spina bifida.

ca4036356d66de.s: The UGC Promotion of Equity in HEIs Regulations, 2026, covering SCs, STs and OBCs, align with Articles:
ca4036356d66de.x: The regulations align with Articles 15(4) and 15(5); OBCs were excluded only in the draft.

ca42acc8080fc8.s: Under the 16th Finance Commission's horizontal devolution criteria, income distance carries a weight of:
ca42acc8080fc8.x: Income distance has 42.5%, 2011 population 17.5% and demographic performance 10%.

cacace50d4521e.s: The Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority has powers over how many subjects?
cacace50d4521e.x: The Authority has powers over 46 subjects, including land use, agriculture, rural development and infrastructure.

cadfa864a4b183.s: Which Article, concerning Nagaland's customary law, remains intact under the Frontier Nagaland Territorial Authority agreement?
cadfa864a4b183.x: Article 371(A) remains intact; the Authority covers Kiphire, Longleng, Mon, Noklak, Shamator and Tuensang.

ca24553ea8994b.s: Under the Rah-Veer (Good Samaritan) Scheme, a helper receives a reward of:
ca24553ea8994b.x: The reward is ₹25,000; the scheme is under Section 134A of the MV (Amendment) Act, 2019.

ca69fbb3db8691.s: The 'Uday' mascot was unveiled in January 2026 by:
ca69fbb3db8691.x: The Uday mascot was unveiled by UIDAI, not MoSPI.

cad1394a7ba487.s: PRAHAAR, India's first national counter-terrorism policy, was released by the Ministry of Home Affairs on:
cad1394a7ba487.x: PRAHAAR was released on 23 February 2026 and has seven pillars, including Prevention and Recovery and resilience.

ne72ac9979b7.s: Which grants were dropped in the 16th Finance Commission award, drawing criticism that it placed efficiency above equity?
ne72ac9979b7.x: Revenue-deficit grants were dropped and the income-distance weight was reduced.

ca9cb56bd1d977.s: Section 66A of the IT Act was struck down in:
ca9cb56bd1d977.x: Section 66A was struck down in Shreya Singhal (2015).

ca1c9c2e3861a4.s: The University Education Commission headed by Dr. S. Radhakrishnan was set up in:
ca1c9c2e3861a4.x: The University Education Commission dates to 1948, after the Sargeant Report (1944) and the committee for Aligarh, Banaras and Delhi universities (1945).

ca7103e30d14cc.s: Karna-18, a salinity- and drought-tolerant variety reported in January 2026, is intended for:
ca7103e30d14cc.x: Karna-18 is tolerant to salinity and drought and is intended for north-western India.

ca98b823b6f8ea.s: The UGC was inaugurated in 1953 by:
ca98b823b6f8ea.x: The UGC, established in 1952, was inaugurated by Maulana Abul Kalam Azad in 1953 and became statutory under the UGC Act, 1956.

ca8dbbb75df948.s: According to the World Malaria Report 2025, malaria cases in the Asia-Pacific region fell from 9.6 million in 2023 to:
ca8dbbb75df948.x: Cases fell from 9.6 million to 8.9 million, with 10 of 17 endemic countries recording declines, making the region a bright spot.

cadffbd214e1d2.s: Under National Monetisation Pipeline 2.0, which supports the National Infrastructure Pipeline:
o: Ownership remains with the government while revenue rights are leased
Ownership is transferred while the government keeps revenue rights
Both ownership and revenue rights are sold
cadffbd214e1d2.x: Under NMP 2.0 government ownership is retained while revenue rights are leased.

caaf95a4c21046.s: Which horizontal devolution criterion was removed by the 16th Finance Commission when 'contribution to GDP' was newly added?
caaf95a4c21046.x: The tax and fiscal effort criterion was removed and contribution to GDP was added.

cacdcde4c94d7c.s: The Bezbaruah Committee of 2014 dealt with:
cacdcde4c94d7c.x: The Bezbaruah Committee dealt with racial and regional discrimination; mob lynching guidelines came from Tehseen Poonawalla (2018).

cab1f6c87ffaa3.s: With reference to the Governor's role, which of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: Nabam Rebia (2016) – Articles 175 and 176 are exercised on ministerial advice
State of Tamil Nadu v. Governor of Tamil Nadu (2024) – Discretion cannot stall an elected government
Shamsher Singh (1974) – Governor as the 'lynchpin of cooperative federalism'
Sarkaria Commission (1988) – Governor as the 'lynchpin of cooperative federalism'
cab1f6c87ffaa3.x: Shamsher Singh (seven-judge bench) held the Governor is a constitutional head acting on aid and advice; the 'lynchpin' phrase is from the Sarkaria Commission.

cab063114d3d06.s: Which of the following cases on legislative privileges is NOT correctly matched?
o: Pandit M.S.M. Sharma v. Sri Krishna Sinha – Privileges under Article 194(3) prevail over press freedom
Sita Soren v. Union of India – Immunity for bribes linked to speech or vote
P.V. Narasimha Rao – Immunity for bribes linked to speech or vote
State of Kerala v. K. Ajith – Privileges do not override criminal law
cab063114d3d06.x: Sita Soren overruled the JMM bribery (P.V. Narasimha Rao) case and held that bribery is not protected.

cac9a9070af0e3.s: Which of the following cases concerning the Speaker is NOT correctly matched?
o: Kihoto Hollohan (1993) – Disqualification pleas should be decided within three months
Nabam Rebia (2016) – Speaker cannot decide disqualification while a removal notice is pending
Keisham Meghachandra Singh (2020) – Disqualification pleas should be decided within three months
Subhash Desai (2023) – Speaker should set timelines
cac9a9070af0e3.x: Kihoto Hollohan held that the Speaker's Tenth Schedule decisions are subject to judicial review; the three-month period is from Keisham Meghachandra Singh.

ca962facfb3e91.s: Which of the following is NOT correct according to the MHA Year End Review 2025?
o: I4C launched e-Zero FIR for automatic registration of FIRs in cyber financial crimes
The four-pillar cyber strategy comprises Convergence, Coordination, Communication and Capacity
The new criminal laws completed two years in 2025
ca962facfb3e91.x: The new criminal laws completed one year, not two, in 2025.

ca47daf7cb6aa6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about IICDEM–2026?
o: It brought together about 100 delegates from about 70 countries
It featured 36 thematic groups and showcased the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
It was held at Bharat Mandapam
It was held under CEC Rajiv Kumar
ca47daf7cb6aa6.x: The CEC at the time was Gyanesh Kumar, not Rajiv Kumar.

cae4e085b8b59e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's nuclear-sector framework?
o: Appeals under the nuclear-damage redressal mechanism lie with the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity
The Atomic Energy Act, 1948 replaced the Atomic Energy Act, 1962
India's new nuclear-power target is 100 GW by 2047
The SHANTI Act, 2025 replaced the Atomic Energy Act, 1962 and the CLNDA, 2010
cae4e085b8b59e.x: The chronology is reversed: the Atomic Energy Act, 1962 replaced the 1948 Act.

caa341819c5a20.shape: one-liner (no dated items for a sequence)
caa341819c5a20.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the rights of religious denominations?
caa341819c5a20.x: Article 26 concerns religious denominations; Article 25 concerns individual freedom of religion.

ca31c490c6c010.s: The Committee of Privileges of the Lok Sabha has how many members?
ca31c490c6c010.x: The Lok Sabha committee has 15 members and the Rajya Sabha committee 10.

cabdab55afa47a.s: The Bembla Irrigation Project, reviewed under PRAGATI, was commissioned on:
cabdab55afa47a.x: The Bembla project, approved in 2007, was commissioned on 30 June 2025.

cac55e6ad80e2c.s: The Electoral Trusts Scheme was introduced by the CBDT in:
cac55e6ad80e2c.x: CBDT introduced the Electoral Trusts Scheme in 2013.

ca063358d448f8.s: Which Supreme Court case concerned the ban on child labour in hazardous industries?
ca063358d448f8.x: M.C. Mehta vs Tamil Nadu (1996) dealt with child labour in hazardous industries; Vishal Jeet treated trafficking as a socio-economic problem.

ca4ecff169c00c.s: The right to die with dignity, relevant in the Harish Rana case, is part of which Article?
ca4ecff169c00c.x: Article 21 includes the right to die with dignity; passive euthanasia is legal under guidelines.

caf74280b8f42e.s: Which Article deals with the oath of the Governor?
caf74280b8f42e.x: Article 159 deals with the Governor's oath; Article 163 concerns aid and advice of the Council of Ministers.

ca2e71a8f58c12.s: The biggest-ever anti-Naxal operation in the Karreguttalu Hills was conducted along the border of:
ca2e71a8f58c12.x: The operation on the Chhattisgarh–Telangana border eliminated 31 Naxalites in 21 days with no SF casualties.

ca0fff6e2d40c3.s: In 2024–25, electoral trusts received donations totalling:
ca0fff6e2d40c3.x: Electoral trusts received ₹3,826.35 crore, of which the BJP got ₹3,157.66 crore.

ca7a9ed160cabb.s: The Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976 was first promulgated as an ordinance on:
ca7a9ed160cabb.x: It was first promulgated as an ordinance on 25 October 1975 and completed 50 years in February 2026.

ca29d9e01ec8be.s: Article 233 of the Constitution deals with the appointment of:
ca29d9e01ec8be.x: Article 233 concerns district judges; Articles 124 and 214 relate to the Supreme Court and High Courts.

n2df63033bd6.s: The SHANTI Act, 2025 caps nuclear liability at:
n2df63033bd6.x: The SHANTI Act caps liability at 300 million SDR and has no supplier liability.

nff5511aa282.s: The first India International Conference on Democracy and Election Management (IIC-DEM), January 2026, was held at:
nff5511aa282.x: IIC-DEM 2026 was held at Bharat Mandapam (21–23 January 2026), organised by IIIDEM.

cabd4be8174770.s: Which Section of the BNS, 2023 includes organ removal within trafficking?
cabd4be8174770.x: Section 143 of the BNS, 2023 includes organ removal within trafficking.

ca23c20c46cca2.s: The Telangana Assembly bill permanently removed which bar for Panchayat, Mandal and Zilla Praja Parishad polls?
ca23c20c46cca2.x: The bill permanently removed the two-child bar for these local-body polls.

ca297799262859.s: Which case created the collegium system for appointing judges?
ca297799262859.x: The Second Judges case created the collegium system; the First Judges case resulted in executive primacy.

caebd2e610a812.s: As per the MHA Year End Review 2025, the NIA conviction rate was approximately:
caebd2e610a812.x: The NIA conviction rate was approximately 95%, not 85%.

caea518f7911f8.s: Which Article of the Constitution prohibits forced labour?
caea518f7911f8.x: Article 23 prohibits forced labour, while Article 21 protects dignity.

cad7d35ee9d050.s: Under the Kerala Nativity Card Bill, the Nativity Card becomes invalid on:
cad7d35ee9d050.x: The card becomes invalid on acquiring foreign citizenship; it serves as official identity for state services, benefits and reservations.

ca9140b58e5728.s: The Governor reserves Bills for the consideration of the President under Article:
ca9140b58e5728.x: Bills are reserved under Article 200; Article 356 concerns President's Rule.

cafcf63fe32610.s: The Supreme Court's 2023 simplification of passive euthanasia reduced the experience requirement for board members from 20 years to:
cafcf63fe32610.x: The reforms reduced the requirement to 5 years, with two boards, a three-member board and a 48-hour deadline.

ca1864bedaf5ef.s: A notice for removal of the Speaker must be given in writing to the Secretary-General at least how many days in advance?
ca1864bedaf5ef.x: The notice must be given at least 14 days in advance; 50 members must support the motion.

ca41ab0306dc04.s: In the Sabarimala case, the Anti-Exclusion Test focusing on dignity and equality was proposed by:
ca41ab0306dc04.x: Justice D.Y. Chandrachud proposed the Anti-Exclusion Test; the September 2018 decision was 4:1.

ca033b965d2e27.s: The Official Secrets Act, which applies to defence personnel even after retirement, was enacted in:
ca033b965d2e27.x: The Official Secrets Act dates to 1923 and continues to apply after retirement.

ca521d353ee539.s: As held in the Rajasthan High Court (1966) and Syed Habibullah cases, procedural defects in delivering the Governor's address:
o: Invalidate all proceedings of the session
Do not invalidate the legislative proceedings
Invalidate only the Bills passed in that session
Require the address to be delivered again
ca521d353ee539.x: These cases held that procedural defects in delivery do not invalidate the proceedings.

ca465d9338dbc1.s: Under the Kerala Nativity Card Bill, the issuing authority for the Nativity Card is the:
ca465d9338dbc1.x: The Tahsildar issues the card; an appeal lies to the District Collector.

ca9798862b0a7c.s: Women aged 10–50 were barred at Sabarimala because Lord Ayyappa is regarded as a:
ca9798862b0a7c.x: The bar rested on Lord Ayyappa being a Naishtika Brahmachari; Justice Indu Malhotra's dissent emphasised respect for essential religious practice.

cadd4aa30c328e.s: The Right to Disconnect Bill, 2025 gives employees the right:
o: To respond to work calls beyond working hours for overtime pay
To work from home on two days a week
Not to respond to work calls and emails beyond working hours
cadd4aa30c328e.x: The Bill's central provision is a right not to respond to work calls and emails beyond working hours.

cad7c307fee543.s: Judicial independence was recognised as part of the basic structure in which case of 1973?
cad7c307fee543.x: Kesavananda Bharati (1973) recognised judicial independence as part of the basic structure.
